data.name: Justine
data.gender_notes: Justine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'dikaiosyne' meaning 'justice, righteousness'. In Christianity, Justine is the name of several saints and martyrs, including the legendary 'Justina of Padua' who was known for her unwavering faith and miraculous healings. The name Justine carries the meaning “Fair, righteous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Justine usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, righteous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Justine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fair, righteous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Justine total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: ג'וסטין
in_hebrew.meaning: השם ג'וסטין הוא נגזר מהמילה הלטינית שמשמעותה צדיק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'וסטין מקורו במילה הלטינית 'יוסטוס' שמשמעותה צדיק או הוגן. המילה עצמה נגזרת מהשורש הלטיני 'יוס' שמשמעותו להיות מחובר או מאוחד. השם ג'וסטין הוא גרסה נוצרית של השם העברי 'צדוק' שגם הוא מתייחס לצדק וחוכמה. השם ג'וסטין היה בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים עוד מימי קדם והוא נושא משמעות רבה בתרבות הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Ιουστίνη
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Ιουστίνη σημαίνει δίκαιος ή δίκαιη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιουστίνη προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα 'Iustina' που σημαίνει δίκαιος ή δίκαιη. Η λέξη 'Iustina' είναι η θηλυκή μορφή του ονόματος 'Iustus' που σημαίνει δίκαιος. Το όνομα αυτό ήταν γνωστό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και Ρώμη και είχε μεγάλη σημασία στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία Χριστού. Η Ιουστίνη είναι η μορφή της γυναικείας πλευράς του ονόματος Ιουστίνος που σημαίνει αυτός που είναι δίκαιος.

in_latin.name: Justine
in_latin.meaning: The name Justine means just or righteous
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Justine originates from the Latin name 'Iustina', which is derived from 'Iustus', meaning just or righteous. This name was popularized in Christian tradition due to several early Christian martyrs and saints bearing the name. The name Justine symbolizes moral integrity, justice, and righteousness, reflecting the Christian values of fairness and compassion.

in_english.name: Justine

Historically, Justine has been associated with several Christian saints and martyrs, adding to its spiritual significance. The name represents virtues of fairness, integrity, and compassion, making it a meaningful choice for Christian families.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Justine: Derived from the Latin word "iustus," meaning "just" or "righteous." The name symbolizes moral integrity, fairness, and a commitment to doing what is right. It's a reminder to live in accordance with divine justice and to strive for inner purity.

historical_references.reference: Justine, a martyr of the early Christian Church, is mentioned in the 'Acts of the Martyrs of Lyons and Vienne' (c. 177 AD). She was a young girl who was martyred along with her mother and brother during the persecution of Christians by the Roman Emperor Marcus Aurelius.
